"""Structural invariants every certificate must satisfy."""
def check(cert):
    st = cert['state']
    assert len(st) == 32 and all(isinstance(v, int) and v >= 0 for v in st), st
    assert st[30] == 0, ('slot overwrites must be zero', st[30])
    assert st[31] == 0, ('reserved must be zero', st[31])
    assert st[22] + st[23] + st[24] + st[25] == st[18], ('DATA classification total', st)
    assert st[28] <= st[19], ('ignored <= accepted acks', st)
    assert st[20] + st[21] == cert['packets'], ('emission counters', st, cert['packets'])
    for r in range(4):
        assert st[14 + r] <= st[2 + r], ('U <= R', st)          # upstream sent <= received
        assert st[10 + r] <= st[6 + r], ('down <= sent', st)
    assert len(cert['buffer']) == 16 and all(ch in '0123456789abcdef' for ch in cert['buffer'])
    assert len(cert['wire_sha256']) == 64
    assert cert['bytes'] >= 0
    for entry in cert['trace']:
        assert set(entry) == {'rank', 'hex'}
        assert 0 <= entry['rank'] < 4
        assert len(entry['hex']) % 2 == 0
    for snap in cert['snapshots']:
        assert set(snap) == {'tag', 'state', 'buffer', 'wire_sha256', 'packets', 'bytes'}
        check({**snap, 'trace': [], 'snapshots': []})
PYEOF
